title: Failure Signal Garden and Inference Fault Rubric
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build a unified dashboard and classification rubric (the 'Signal Garden') that surfaces inference failures across stack layers and maps them to a small, actionable taxonomy for oncall and engineering: Timeouts, Overload/Backpressure, Model Rejections/Rate-limits, Model Runtime Errors (OOM/NaN/Bad-weights), and Protocol Errors (HTTP/gRPC codes). This ticket covers the schema, dashboard UX, trace enrichment hooks, metrics/log pipeline transforms, and expected alerts/SLIs for each bucket.
background: Current problem: multiple dashboards and ad-hoc charts exist that show latency and errors but they do not consistently attribute root cause. Oncall spends cycles guessing whether a 504 came from model timeout vs network proxy vs overloaded GPU. We need structured failure labels emitted at request completion plus an aggregated dashboard that summarizes distribution, recent spikes, and exemplar traces per bucket. This work ties into the tracing hooks pipeline and the metric/log enrichment effort in the infra roadmap.
acceptance_criteria: A consistent failure taxonomy documented and approved by SRE, Serving, and Platform teams
Tracing hooks instrumented to emit 'failure_label' and 'failure_hint' at request end for at least text-generation endpoints
Pipeline transforms that map raw error signals (latency, status codes, model exception types) into taxonomy buckets with confidence score
A dashboard 'Signal Garden' that shows: per-bucket counts, 1h/6h/24h trends, per-model and per-route breakdowns, and top 10 exemplar traces for each bucket
Alerts for sudden bucket-rate increase (configurable) and SLO breach tied to buckets (e.g., model-error spike)
Documentation with playbook entries and recommended remediation steps per bucket
tasks: Design taxonomy and mapping matrix with SRE/Serving/Platform
Add trace-enrichment hook (end-of-request) to runtime to populate failure_label + failure_hint
Add telemetry pipeline transform rule in metrics/log pipeline to normalize error payloads
Create dashboard panels for Signal Garden (overview, bucket detail, per-model slice, exemplar traces)
Implement exemplar trace sampler and link to Trace Explorer
Create alerts and SLO mappings for each failure bucket
Write runbook/playbook entries and sample remediation steps
updates: 2026-03-01: Kickoff meeting completed with SRE, Serving, and Platform. Agreed on five top-level buckets: timeout, overload, model_error, protocol_error, degraded_result. Added 'failure_hint' free-text for ambiguous cases.
2026-03-04: PoC tracing hook implemented in runtime: adds fields 'failure_label' and 'failure_hint' to span and end-of-request event. Hook currently enabled for canary runtime only.

2026-03-08: Telemetry team proposed a normalization transform that merges HTTP 502/503/504 into protocol_error unless model-side exception present. We debated trade-offs: losing signal vs preventing double-attribution. Decided to keep both raw_code and mapped_bucket with confidence score.

2026-03-10: Dashboard wireframes reviewed by Design. Requested explicit exemplar trace widget and a confidence slider to filter lower-confidence mappings. UX asked for quick 'suggested action' pill per bucket (e.g., 'scale GPU pool', 'review model logs').

2026-03-13: Implemented pipeline mapping rules in staging. Initial smoke test on a synthetic workload produced clear separation between overload (queue_time spikes + resource pressure labels) and model_error (runtime exception messages + OOM).

2026-03-14: Created initial Grafana dashboard in staging and added to design review backlog. Next steps: expand tracing hook to all runtimes, integrate exemplar trace links, and author playbook entries.
notes: Trade-offs: mapping HTTP/gRPC codes to root cause is lossy; we will emit both raw and mapped fields and surface confidence. Over time we can train a lightweight classifier on labeled incidents to improve mapping.
Sampling: to avoid costs, exemplar traces will be sampled deterministically for each unique error signature (hash of model+route+label) and capped per-minute.
Rollout plan: enable tracing hook in canary (runtime-1.27-canary) -> collect 2 weeks of data -> refine mapping rules -> rollout to production with flag and monitor.
